primarySource.paper: Bettin-Gonek, 'The theta = infinity conjecture implies the Riemann hypothesis'
primarySource.conjecture: Farmer: formula (1.2) lim_{T->oo} I_{T^th}(0,T)/T = 1 + 1/th (proven for 0 < th < 1/2: Levinson 1974 / Conrey 1989) is conjectured to hold for EVERY th > 0 = the 'theta = infinity conjecture'. I_N(T1,T2) = int_{T1}^{T2} |M_N(1/2+it)|^2 |zeta(1/2+it)|^2 dt, M_N(s) = sum_{n<=N} mu(n)/n^s (1 - log n / log N).
primarySource.theorem1VerbatimShape: Let th > 0 and assume that for every eps > 0 we have I_N(0,T) <<_eps T^{1+eps} for N in the range 2 <= N <= T^th. Then zeta(s) has no zeros in the half-plane Re s > 1/2 + 1/(2th). In particular, if I_N(0,T) <<_eps T^{1+eps} for 2 <= N <= T^th with th arbitrarily large, then the Riemann hypothesis is true.
primarySource.consequenceChain: Farmer proved the conjecture implies kappa = 1 (100% of the zeros on the line); Theorem 1 with th arbitrarily large gives the same as a zero-free-region statement.
primarySource.extension2026: ALIVE AND ACTIVE: arXiv:2605.24363 extends the implication to cuspidal automorphic L-functions (GL_m), 2026.
primarySource.unconditionalRecord: at least 2/3 of the zeros on the line (Conrey-Chandee-Farb-Young)

definitions: thetaMoll (Y : Real) (s : Complex) : Complex - the Levinson mollifier M_Y(s) = sum_{n <= floor Y} mu(n) exp(-s log n) (1 - log n / log Y), total in Y, standard for Y >= 2 (ArithmeticFunction.moebius in this mathlib pin)
thetaIMoment (Y : Real) (T1 T2 : Real) : Real - int_{T1..T2} |M_Y(1/2+it)|^2 |zeta(1/2+it)|^2 dt
thetaInfConjecture : Prop - FOR ALL th > 0: Tendsto (T => I_{T^th}(0,T)/T) atTop (nhds (1 + 1/th)) - the EXACT form (1.2)
thetaBounded (th : Real) : Prop - THEOREM-1 ANTECEDENT (fixed th): for all eps > 0 there is C>0, T0>0, for all T >= T0, for all N with 2 <= N <= T^th: I_N(0,T) <= C T^{1+eps}
bgThetaShrink (th : Real) : Prop - CITED (Theorem 1 + functional-equation reflection): thetaBounded th => for all s: (1/2 + 1/(2th)) < s.re or s.re < (1/2 - 1/(2th)) => zeta s != 0
thetaInfImpliesAllOnLine : Prop - CITED (Farmer kappa=1 + Theorem 1 particular case): thetaInfConjecture => for all rho: zeta rho = 0 => rho.re = 1/2
